observations: The registered raw roots were read successfully after execution and every recorded artifact hash was verified.
Subsequent reads on the same host alternated between the populated tree and ENOENT; later repeated reads exposed only the private split directory.
Multiple no-overwrite mirror attempts could not obtain a consistently readable source tree.
Authoritative sacct records and committed aggregate/hash records remained available.
interpretation: The completed jobs and committed aggregates remain credible, but raw scratch retention is not reliable enough for future paper evidence.
requiredRemediation: Write authoritative future evidence to a versioned project-storage run root.
Use scratch only for replaceable working files.
Atomically stage manifest, shards, aggregate, logs, and scheduler record before job exit.
Verify every staged hash from a separate session before registration.
Rerun critical readiness gates under the remediated storage protocol before protocol freeze.
